name: Export overlaps what is already imported
query: Ich lade nochmal den ganzen September hoch, ich hab vorige Woche schon bis 15.9. importiert.
expected_behavior: Explains that FiBuKI skips lines it already has for that Bank Account, so uploading the whole month again is safe
Does not call list_transactions to compare, and does not filter rows itself
Runs the dry run without --after (or with --after only if the user wants a period), then imports with --import
Reports imported and alreadyImported from the result, e.g. the rows up to 15 September counted as already imported
success_criteria: No client-side duplicate filtering happens in the model or the script call
The user is told how many lines were skipped as already imported
